Smriti Zubin Irani is an Indian politician and former actress, fashion model and producer.
She is a Member of Parliament in the Lok Sabha representing Amethi, Uttar Pradesh.
She made her acting debut in the year 2000 with TV series like Aatish and Hum Hain Kal, Aaj Aur Kal.
She became a household name as her series Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi was
one of the most popular TV soap operas. She is now a prominent personality in Bharatiya Janta Party.
